# Office OS

> Local-first Mac workplace for named AI employees with bounded responsibilities, inspectable work, and owner supervision.

## Product

- [Home](https://office-os.sassmaker.com/): Product overview and workday
- [Release state](https://office-os.sassmaker.com/#release): Public distribution and trust-gate status
- [Privacy](https://office-os.sassmaker.com/#privacy): Data and external-request policy

## Availability and commercial truth

- Working private macOS proof of concept; no public download or source access
- One-time workplace ownership and optional employee subscriptions are the intended model
- No price, checkout, employee marketplace, account system, or public distribution is live

- [Agent catalog](https://office-os.sassmaker.com/api/ai): JSON inventory of public surfaces
- [Homepage markdown](https://office-os.sassmaker.com/index.md): Product brief without JS
